findings.title: Synthetic Alt and Win Backspace invent a known word start
findings.reproduction: SOURCE-ONLY: public send_shortcut alt+backspace passes real parsing/emission/TextPressKey into successful canonical synthetic edit, clearing HSE with KnownBoundary=true; equivalent physical Alt+Backspace sets unknown false. Unbound focus re-admission preserves the synthetic true, so a word-only mapping can fire after the unknown undo/delete position.
findings.root_cause: HS_CommitSyntheticEffect uses one successful-edit boundary verdict for every generic edit; unlike the physical modified-Backspace branch it does not distinguish known Ctrl word deletion from unknown Alt/Win undo/delete semantics.
findings.silent_failure: The sender and context commit both succeed, and the diagnostic only says buffers reset. No exception identifies the invented boundary. Existing physical Alt+Backspace behavioral test explicitly requires unknown but does not compare the public synthetic sibling.
findings.regression_test: Actual AHK parsed send_shortcut/TextPressKey/canonical effect and real physical keydown: compare Ctrl/Alt/Win/Shift Backspace boundary and subsequent word-only/in-word matcher decisions, with settings on/off, focus rebinding, Unicode fragments, send refusal. Retain atomic declaration/send and fail-closed unknown contexts.
findings.basis: Exact-source deduction; no AHK execution, behavior translation, native application or network receipt

findings.title: Physical editing shortcut branches preserve obsolete complete AI context
findings.reproduction: SOURCE-ONLY: complete active prediction context OLD_WORD with reset_on_nav=true, or agent-only context with active typing feed; Ctrl+Backspace deletes the word (or Ctrl+A then x replaces selection), then type x in stable focus. Real prefix-hook early branch resets only HSE/preview; incomplete-only bridge discard preserves complete AI context. Next char appends x, fresh observer captures current physical generation and forwards obsolete OLD_WORDx to engine/agent.
findings.root_cause: LLM key forwarding sits below the physical shortcut/modified-Backspace early returns. Prefix context mutation only discards incomplete UTF16; bridge dispatcher fallback intentionally returns while prefix hook exists. Synthetic key declarations similarly have no complete AI-context edit while SendLevel0 prevents hook echo.
findings.silent_failure: All strings and newly captured generation/focus receipts are valid. Old observer/output fences work but do not detect a new owner carrying obsolete semantic text. Length diagnostics and direct bridge navigation tests do not cover real prefix shortcut branching. No actual network or persistence measured.
findings.regression_test: Genuine AHK real prefix keydown and actual bridge/agent owners: complete contexts after Ctrl+Backspace and Ctrl+A replacement must match empty/known edited text before next real engine/agent observer. Include inactive requests, CtrlZ/Y/V/F/L, Alt/Win, reset_on_nav policy, tap-hold modifier and command/synthetic sources, stale/focus/pause/refused output; keep self-echo disabled and stale-owner admission intact.
findings.basis: Exact-source deduction; no AHK execution, behavior translation, native application or network receipt
